TOMISLAV MESARIĆ
Ulica Lipa 12, 10000 Zagreb, Croatia | +385 1 555 0142 | tomislav.mesaric@example.com

PROFESSIONAL PROFILE
Butcher with 11 years of meat-counter and butchery experience, including carcass breakdown, boning, trimming, portioning and fresh sausage production. Experienced in customer service, FIFO stock rotation, temperature and hygiene checks, and training apprentices. Holds a vocational butcher certificate and a basic HACCP food hygiene certificate.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Butcher | Mesnica Kod Ante (family butcher shop), Zagreb | 2019–present
- Break down 2–3 beef forequarters and 10–12 pork sides weekly; bone, trim and portion meat for the counter.
- Produce approximately 40 kg of fresh sausage weekly in the busy season, including ćevapi, kobasice, chipolata and lamb merguez.
- Developed the shop’s lamb merguez recipe and adjusted the ćevapi mix to 70% beef and 30% lamb in response to customer feedback; the ćevapi won second place at the 2023 Zagreb County craft meat fair.
- Rotate cold-room stock each morning using FIFO, placing the oldest products at the front.
- Record cold-room (0–4 °C) and display-counter temperature checks twice daily.
- Serve approximately 120 customers on a Saturday and advise on meat cuts and cooking times.
- Train two apprentices in knife handling and cleaning routines.
- Prepare whole lambs and suckling pigs for spit-roasting events, including ordering, butchering, seasoning and delivery. Largest order: four lambs and two pigs for a 180-guest wedding in 2024.
- Conducted a six-week dry-ageing trial of beef ribs at 21 and 28 days, recording temperature and weight loss. Dry-aged rib is now sold by pre-order, at approximately 15 kg per month.

Counter Assistant | Tržnica Dolac meat hall stall, Zagreb | 2015–2019
- Served customers, weighed and priced orders, operated the till and completed cash-up.
- Cleaned and sanitised the slicer, mincer and counter at closing.
- Created a one-page closing and cleaning checklist following a hygiene inspection remark; the checklist remains in use at the stall.

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATES
Vocational Certificate: Butcher (3-year programme) | Food Trades School Zagreb | 2015
HACCP Basic Food Hygiene Certificate | 2021; renewed 2024
Preparing for the Master Butcher Exam (majstorski ispit), planned for spring 2027

KEY SKILLS
Carcass breakdown: beef, pork and lamb · Boning, trimming and portioning · Fresh sausage making · FIFO stock rotation · HACCP food hygiene · Cold-chain temperature checks · Customer advice on cuts and cooking · Knife sharpening · Mincer and bandsaw operation · Cleaning and sanitising equipment · Cash handling · Apprentice training

LANGUAGES
Croatian (native) · English (good; customer service) · German (basic)

critique.content_quality_feedback: Strong, clear, and highly relevant CV with a logical structure, quantified production and customer-service achievements, relevant certificates, and credible evidence of butchery expertise. The project details substantially improve impact: sausage development, dry-ageing, event preparation, and the hygiene checklist demonstrate initiative beyond routine counter work. The document is professional and easy to scan. The main content issue is the stated “11 years” of experience, which conflicts with the supplied original CV’s “9 years” and should be reconciled before submission.
critique.ats_compatibility_feedback: Very good ATS compatibility: standard section headings, plain text formatting, conventional job titles, date ranges, and strong keywords such as “carcass breakdown,” “boning,” “portioning,” “FIFO,” “HACCP,” “temperature checks,” “customer service,” and “fresh sausage.” The CV should parse reliably and has a high ATS/AI screening probability for the advertised role. Adding the exact target title “Butcher / Meat Counter Assistant” near the name or in the profile would improve title matching. The CV does not claim unsupported supermarket, self-service packaging, or forklift experience, which is appropriate.
critique.job_alignment_feedback: Excellent alignment with the two must-have requirements. The CV demonstrates completed butcher training, substantially more than two years of meat-counter experience, HACCP knowledge, fresh-meat cutting and portioning, customer advice, FIFO stock rotation, and temperature checks. It also reflects FreshCart’s priorities around knowledgeable service, hygiene, reliability, and product quality. The candidate has no forklift licence, which is only a nice-to-have and is correctly not claimed. The candidate also has no stated supermarket, tray-sealer, or self-service labelling experience; these are background gaps rather than defects in the CV and should not be presented as supermarket experience.
critique.improvement_instructions:
CRITICAL: In the Professional Profile, resolve the experience discrepancy. The current wording says “11 years,” while the original candidate information says “9 years.” Use the accurate figure confirmed by the candidate, or avoid the disputed total with wording such as “Butcher with experience in high-street, market, and family-shop butchery since 2015.” Ensure the same figure is used consistently throughout the CV.

MINOR: In the Professional Profile heading or immediately below the name, add the target role title “Butcher / Meat Counter Assistant” so the document matches the advertised job title more directly. For example: “BUTCHER / MEAT COUNTER ASSISTANT” followed by the existing profile.

MINOR: In the Key Skills section, change “Customer advice on cuts and cooking” to “Customer advice on meat cuts, quantities and cooking” only if the candidate genuinely advises on quantities; otherwise retain the current wording. This would mirror the advertisement more closely without overstating experience.
critique.critical_issues: The Professional Profile states “11 years of meat-counter and butchery experience,” but the Original CV states “9 years.” This is a material factual inconsistency and could be viewed as an unsupported claim unless the candidate confirms that the 11-year figure is correct.

critique.content_quality_feedback: This is a strong, highly relevant CV. It is clearly structured, professional, easy to scan, and supported by specific evidence: meat volumes, customer numbers, sausage production, temperature ranges, apprentice training, catering orders, and the successful dry-ageing trial. The profile accurately summarizes the candidate's experience and qualifications. The added projects and achievements materially strengthen the CV without introducing unsupported claims. No significant content or professionalism defects are apparent.
critique.ats_compatibility_feedback: The CV uses a conventional, ATS-friendly structure with standard headings, chronological experience, clear job titles, dates, and relevant keywords such as butcher, meat counter, carcass breakdown, boning, trimming, portioning, FIFO, HACCP, temperature checks, customer service, and sausage making. The job title matches the advertisement exactly. The document should have a high AI/ATS screening probability for this role. A very minor enhancement would be to use the exact phrase "HACCP knowledge" in addition to the existing certificate wording, since that is the wording used in the requirement. No problematic formatting, tables, graphics, or unsupported keyword stuffing is present.
critique.job_alignment_feedback: Alignment is excellent. The CV shows the two must-have requirements: completed butcher training and substantially more than two years of meat-counter experience, plus HACCP knowledge. It strongly matches the role's cutting, portioning, customer-advice, FIFO, temperature-check, hygiene, and counter-service duties. The candidate's quantified customer service and product-advice experience also fits FreshCart's emphasis on knowledgeable, helpful service. The candidate does not have a forklift licence, which is a stated nice-to-have gap rather than a CV defect. The candidate has not worked in a supermarket and has not used tray-sealing or self-service labelling equipment; these are relevant background gaps, but the advertisement does not list them as mandatory requirements. The CV appropriately does not claim those experiences. The planned Master Butcher Exam is correctly presented as preparation rather than as a completed qualification.
critique.improvement_instructions: MINOR ATS ENHANCEMENT — In the Professional Profile or Key Skills section, change the existing wording "HACCP food hygiene" to "HACCP knowledge and food hygiene" or add the exact phrase "HACCP knowledge" after the existing HACCP certificate statement. This mirrors the advertisement's wording without overstating the candidate's qualification. No other meaningful CV changes are required.
